archive.binding_mode_note: content_first, not commit-diff strict, and DECLARED IN ADVANCE. This archive binds the two blind review packages, which a session hook commits as they are written, alongside the ledger records it introduces itself and the batch-level Coordinator documents committed before the round opened. No single commit's diff-tree can show files that different commits introduced, so strict per-commit-diff verification cannot apply; content_first verifies every declared hash against the tree instead, with the cited commit required to be real, reachable, and to name this task id and every record_id in its message. A CONTENT MISMATCH REMAINS FATAL. Per CLAUDE.md, receipts bind to CONTENT first and commit reachability is advisory; DEC-20260823-ee9162 R9(e) supersedes the earlier claim that this pattern makes the completed-archive check unsatisfiable.
